strings.subtitle: — Muchisi wa tifayili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ku koka ni ku tshika a swi kumeki. Tirhisa buti leyi nga ehansi.
strings.ft_lnk: Ndhawu yo koma (.lnk) — yi ta alela
strings.strategy_full_small_short: ☢  HI YO HETISEKA (fayili < 1 GB, yi tiyimela)
strings.strategy_fast: ⚡  HI KU HATLISA — milayini ya 4 MB
strings.strategy_full: ☢  HI YO HETISEKA — hinkwaswo hi zero (ntiyiseko)
strings.ssd_warning:
Xitiviso! Eka SSD, ndlela yo tsala ehenhla a yi tiyisisi ku chisa hikwalaho ka TRIM.
Nongonoko lowu i wa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayili "{name}" yi ta tsariwa ehenhla ni ku susiwa.

Yisa emahlweni?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Leri i xikhombo-xikhetsho (.lnk). I xikhombo-xikhetsho ntsena lexi ta lovisiwa.

Fayili leyi xi yi kombaka yi ta tshama yi hlayisekile.

Humelela?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Leri i dayirekiti ya netiweke (\\server\share).
Ku tsala ehenhla ka swiyenge a swi tiyisisi ku lovisiwa — sevha yi nga va ni swifaniso, deduplication kumbe CoW.

Humelela?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Leri i dayirekiti leyi susumekaka (USB / HDD ya le handle).
Mulawuri a nga hlayisa tibuloko ta khale endhawini yo hlayisa.

Humelela?
strings.dont_ask_again: U nga ha tshuki u vutisa
strings.dont_show_again: U nga ha tshuki u kombisa
strings.error_cannot_read:
A ndzi swi koti ku hlaya fayili:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAYILI YI TSARIWILE EHENHLA NI KU SUSIWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mindzilekano yin'wana ya data (ADS) a yi tirhi.
• Buku ra USN a ri basisiwi.
• Tikhophi ta nsinya ni ku hlanganyeta ka mapapa
  (OneDrive ni swin'wana) a swi khumbeki.
strings.status_full: Leswi nga endzeni swi tsariwile ehenhla hi zero hinkwaswo. Ku tlherisela a swi koteki — switirhisiwa swi ta vona zero ntsena.
strings.status_fast: Nhloko, mongo ni milayini ya 4 MB swi tsariwile ehenhla. Leswi saleke a swi khumbekanga, kambe hikwalaho ka minkhawa, ku tlherisela hinkwaswo hi switirhisiwa swa mutirhisi a swi koteki. Eka mapapila ya xihundla tirhisa MODE HI YO HETISEKA.
strings.status_empty: Fayili a yi ri hava nkoko, ku tsala ehenhla a swi laveki. Yi susiwile.
strings.error_permission: A yi swi koti ku fikelela fayili. Yi nga va yi pfuriwile eka programe yin'wana. Pfala yi tirhise nakambe.
strings.error_not_found: Fayili a yi kumekangi. Yi nga va yi susiwile kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Leri i xikhombo xa xikombiso. Swikhombo a swi swi koti ku lovisiwa — fayili leyi xi yi kombaka yi ta tshama yi hlayisekile.
strings.error_reparse: Leri i fayili yo rhurhela (OneDrive kumbe swo ka swona). Datha ya yona yi hlayisiwile edzongeni, a hi eka dayirekiti — a ku na nchumu wo lovisa laha.
strings.error_not_file: Leri a hi fayili (foldere kumbe xin'wana). Rhurhela fayili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayili leyi yi na hard link yin'wana ({n} hinkwato). Hard link a ti na yo sungula — mavito hinkwawo ya ringana. Loko u lovisa hi ndlela ya sweswi, datha yi ta tsariwa ehenhla ni ku tsemiwa eka 32 bytes, kambe leswi saleke swi ta fikeleleka hi swikhombo swin'wana. Susa swikhombo hinkwaswo sungula.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayili yi pfariwile, yi tsariwile hi xihlawulekisi kumbe yi ri sparse. Ku tsala hi zero a swi tiyisisi ku lovisiwa ka datha ya khale hikuva NTFS yi yi hlayisa hi ndlela yin'wana.

Susa xihlawulekisi: tshikelela xinene → Swihlawulekisi → Swo antswisa → susa 'Pfala' ni/kumbe 'Tsala hi xihlawulekisi'. Endzhaku va tirhisa SHREDDER nakambe.
strings.queue_title: MOKGWA WA KU SUSA HI NKHOMBO
strings.queue_hint: (kumbe u kokota tifayili eka window leyi)
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Ku yima endzhaku ka fayili ya sweswi...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Tifayili ta {count} ti ta lovisiwa.
Vukulu hinkwabyo: {size}.

Kambela nongonoko u nga si humelela.
Xitirho lexi a xi fanelekanga ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Susa tifayili hinkwato ta {count} eka mutsengo?

Tifayili hi toxe A TI TA KHUMBIWA — nongonoko ntsena.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fayili "{name}" yi na hard link yin'wana ({nlink} hinkwato).

Datha yi ta lovisiwa eka mavito hinkwawo.
Kambe leswi saleke (32 bytes) swi ta tshama ehansi ka mavito man'wana eka foldere.

U nga ha lava ku susa leswi saleke hi voko.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Tirhisa eka hard link hinkwato eka mutsengo
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: a yi swi koti ku hlaya vukulu
